response.overview: EASTWOOD follows three young adults who are bored and looking for something to do. After spending some time at a skate park and getting ice cream, they hear about an old mansion that is rumored to be haunted after a woman killed her family and herself inside the house. Curious and looking for an adventure, they decide to explore it. At first, they treat the strange noises and flickering lights as nothing more than their imagination, but the house quickly becomes more disturbing as they continue exploring.
response.title: EASTWOOD
